entailment.quote: hci does not follow intransitive verbs with second-person subjects supports this idea. Since, unlike first- and third-person forms, the plural is clearly indicated by the personal affix eci-, there is no need to additionally mark the subjec

anchor.exact: Like the fourth person in Hokkaido dialects, since the personal affix -an is attached to the plural form of an intransitive verb, whether the subject is semantically single or plural cannot be determined from the form of the verb. It may be the reason why hci is used after the personal affix -an.

statement.en: In Sakhalin Ainu, the first-person plural personal affix -an is used for singular 'I' with plural intransitive verbs, which motivates the addition of ahci (-an ahci) to distinguish true plural number.
statement.ja: 樺太方言において、自動詞の複数形に付加する1人称複数接辞-anは単数の「私」にも用いられるため、真の複数を区別するために人称接辞-anの後にahci（-an ahci）が付加される動機となっている。
